browser_policy: Every fixture page request must have origin http://127.0.0.1:43170; unexpected origin aborts and fails test. Node guard denies non-loopback; harness graph forbids production auth/service adapter imports.
build_policy: Only loopback and fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com permitted; no live service routes invoked.
production_auth_runtime: NOT RUN; original page auth preserved by source/build inspection
sanitization: Exact environment values removed from command captures locally; test-only bearer literal replaced in report/log copies. No .env, auth state, private history, trace or HAR exported.
